message: role="buton" isn’t an ARIA role. Did you mean "button"?
role="widget" is an abstract role for the ARIA ontology; authors must not use it.
role="button" isn’t allowed on <ul> (ARIA in HTML).
role="tab" must be inside an element with role tablist.
role="listitem" must be inside an element with role directory or list.
role="listitem" rebuilds a native element; use <li>, which comes with its behavior.
